services.title: Emergency Vehicle Lockout

services.title: Car Key Replacement
services.desc: Lost your car keys? We supply and programme replacement keys for most makes and models, often cheaper than dealership rates and with no appointment needed.

services.title: Broken Lock Repair
services.desc: Damaged car door lock or ignition cylinder? We repair or replace broken locks on the spot, using quality parts with a 12-month warranty.

services.title: Van and Commercial Vehicle Lockouts
services.desc: We specialise in van lockouts and commercial vehicle access. Fast response keeps your business moving and minimises lost time.

services.title: Spare Key Cutting
services.desc: Need a spare car key cut? We create precision-cut spares while you wait, with full programming for modern vehicles.

services.title: Lock Rekeying and Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade your vehicle security with improved locks or rekeying. We advise on the best solutions for your car or van.

about_pullquote: I started this to make emergency lockouts stress-free and affordable for Sheffield drivers.
about_para_1: Sheffield Auto Locksmith has been helping Sheffield drivers and businesses for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that a lockout shouldn't cost the earth or take all day, we've built our reputation on fast, professional service and transparent pricing. Every technician is trained in non-destructive entry techniques to protect your vehicle while getting you back inside.
about_para_2: We're proud to have unlocked over 2000 vehicles across Sheffield — from family cars to commercial fleets. Customers rely on us because we answer 24/7, arrive quickly, and never charge hidden extras. Whether you're stranded at midnight or need a spare key cut before work, we're the first call Sheffield makes.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out of my car on the motorway junction near Sheffield. Called Sheffield Auto Locksmith at 11pm and they arrived in 45 minutes. Professional, fair price, and sorted it without any damage. Top service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had to get my van unlocked urgently for a work job. They came out same afternoon, very quick work. Would definitely recommend them. Fair price too, not like some of the cowboy outfits around.
reviews.author: Paul D.

reviews.text: Lost my car keys and needed a spare cut fast. Turned up on time, programmed a new key in 30 minutes, and charged me honestly. Been using them for years now. Best locksmith in Sheffield.
reviews.author: Lisa M.
